svg.title: 8-bit calculator: architecture
svg.desc: Two 8-bit numbers are entered on switches. All four arithmetic units compute from both continuously, and the operation switch picks one result in the result selector. The result is converted from binary to decimal and goes to the 7-segment displays. The circuit is fully combinational: ≈ 1–2 µs after a switch flips, the result is on the display.

g.text: 216 chips · no program, ROM or clock: gates do all the work
A ± B; sign and |A − B| when negative
